settings.science: A stabilized, highly effective derivative of kojic acid that works seamlessly to inhibit melanin synthesis, gently fading stubborn discoloration and evening out the natural lip line.

settings.title: Glycolic Acid
settings.science: A micro-exfoliating alpha hydroxy acid that softly dissolves dead skin cells on the surface, accelerating cellular turnover to welcome a smoother, more radiant texture.
settings.good_for: Refining lip texture, Enhancing product absorption

settings.title: Liquorice and Mulberry Extract
settings.science: A dual-action antioxidant blend that naturally illuminates dullness, neutralizes environmental stressors, and helps restore the healthy, inherent rosiness of your lips.
settings.good_for: Soothing delicate skin, Restoring natural lip tone

settings.title: Tulia Physical Sunscreen Gel
settings.description: An ultra-transparent, non-comedogenic zinc oxide shield that leaves zero white patches while providing absolute broad-spectrum protection against UV damage

settings.question: How often should I apply it?
settings.answer: Apply it exclusively at night to let active ingredients safely renew your lips overnight.

settings.question: Can it be used during the day?
settings.answer: Intentionally designed to be used exclusively as part of your nighttime skincare routine, applying it before bed allows the formula to work optimally during the skin's natural overnight renewal cycle

settings.question: When will I see results?
settings.answer: Deep hydration is instant, while visible tone correction typically surfaces within four to six weeks.

settings.question: Is it safe for sensitive lips?
settings.answer: Yes, it balances active brighteners with soothing botanicals, but avoid using it on cracked skin.

settings.question: Does it feel heavy?
settings.answer: No, the premium formula melts immediately into the skin, leaving a lightweight, soft finish.
